description: This file is a PHP source code for a web-based configuration page for Dynamic DNS settings in a networking device. It includes PHP, HTML, JavaScript, and inline scripts to manage UI interactions and AJAX calls for enabling/disabling Dynamic DNS and managing service entries.

methods.name: setupDeleteConfirmDialogs
methods.description: Initializes confirmation dialogs for delete actions on service entries.

methods.name: enableHandler
methods.description: Handles enabling or disabling DNS services based on user interaction with the switch.

methods.name: add_service
methods.description: Navigates to the page for adding new Dynamic DNS service rules, with a limit of 4 rules.
